name: library-surface-non-graph-artifacts
body: `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh`, and `rust-toolchain.toml` each carry a `File` node (`code_type = 'config'`) from the shipped structural scanner, so each is an `implemented-by` or task target addressable by FQN. The library target `src/lib.rs` owns the `rust.apg` module tree and the binary `src/main.rs` roots as `rust.apg-bin`, so the two crate roots carry distinct module identities.
